visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: The Mutable Default Argument
visualizerParams.description: A default value is created once, when the function is defined. A default list would be shared between calls, so use None as the default and create the list inside the function.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
def add_item(item, items=None):
    if items is None:
        items = []
    items.append(item)
    return items


print(add_item("a"))
print(add_item("b"))
